adaptations.ultra_hstu: SLA + exact per-prefix single post-truncation layer; chosen windows are benchmark settings, not unreleased production settings. No LBSL or FP8, preserving the reference supervision and A800 compatibility.
adaptations.dare: ID-only target-conditioned scorer with separate attention/representation embeddings, Top-20 and target cross features. Common per-position sampled-softmax replaces original CTR loss. No batch norm or extra category/time features.
adaptations.ccformer: Independent CCFormer-adapted (arXiv:2607.28070v1): ID-only history, two prefix-derived user tokens and candidate item tokens; three directed cross-field attention flows, local temporal/position mixing, per-channel gated subspace projections and hierarchical Conv1D compression. Triangular temporal/projection masks and left-padded strided convolution enforce causal all-position next-item supervision. Four blocks/dim128/head4, group8/channel16, mixing expansion2, kernel3/stride2, millisecond timestamps scaled to seconds; pre-norm residual paths and a single scalar MLP replace unspecified CTR details, rich user/target features and multitask heads. FuXi shared sampled-softmax and exhaustive-catalog metrics replace original CTR/AUC training. No author-code, production speedup, quantization or paper-result reproduction claim.
